title: I could not find what I was looking for
body: Hi! I have a documentation issue on InstantSearch.js, I could not find what I was looking for which is: If we want to display the facet filters like the picture below, how can we get the values of the widgets after each time the results are rendered? Thank you

comments.body: You can use the [`currentRefinedValues`](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/currentRefinedValues.html) widget for that!
